{{Top|leg}}
'''Gravish Tahane''' was a professional [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who was imprisoned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After escaping from prison for the fifth time, the Republic chose to establish a stronger prison on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
